---
title: "Hospital benchmark"
---

The historical descriptive benchmark is available in [`results/national_historical_benchmark.md`](../results/national_historical_benchmark.md), with period-level and state-by-release summaries in `results/`. Hospital-level output retains scores, reported samples, footnotes, and missing/suppressed components under `data/processed/` after running the Python pipeline.

The project now includes an exploratory empirical-Bayes stability model using repeated, non-overlapping annual windows. It estimates how within-hospital annual residual variation changes with sample size and tests whether shrinkage predicts a held-out year's hospital gap better than an unshrunk prior-year mean. RMSE improved 2.7% in the 2024 holdout and 1.4% in 2025. This validates modest predictive performance only: residual variation includes real hospital changes and is not a patient-level sampling variance or confidence interval for a difference of medians. No hospital rankings are published from it. See the [shrinkage outputs](../results/hospital_gap_shrinkage_metadata.json) and [sample-size sensitivity](../results/sample_size_sensitivity.csv).
